Own the epic-approved minimum economic fold, state, settlement, wire and builder changes required by authenticated booking. Registration burns both tags, donates cost and delivers the singular tag with exact carrier and datum. Termination burns trie-ready and singular tags and donates held minus tip; no processing deadline applies to termination. Ordinary funding pays the fee, state pins and value continue unchanged, and gross allocation equals declared tips. Remove state-spending rejection. Mismatch proofs remain issue 495. Actual application termination integration remains held under Q-003. Do not edit Lean, planning files or another lane.

Read commit-owner, worker-protocol, code-the-design, tdd, gate-script, verification, invariants, worktrees, and applicable Haskell/Nix guidance. Read AGENTS.md and the constitution. Use the selected rows of the mandate, data and modules models; the gate names executable carriers and missing new hosted rows. Submit the reliance declaration, behavioral RED, GREEN receipts and pre-push checkpoint through your own journal. All money, tag, authorization and clock invariants are BLOCKING.

You are not alone in the codebase; do not revert edits made by others. Every cabal build/test, nix build/run, aiken build/check and packaged control runs under this wrapper, with COMMAND replaced by the exact command:

No free-running producer threads; every read loop has a byte cap and deadline. No Co-Authored-By or AI attribution; signed commits only, including commit-tree -S. No push or merge authority. No GitHub comments; read CI with gh run list / gh run view, never gh pr checks. Census open-datum, conformance, journeys, identities and docs/speech consumers and run affected ones locally before the first push. One local just ci precedes push, then hosted CI; never rerun hosted rows locally. Write plain language.

Check inbox before each phase, expensive command and evidence freeze. Questions about model, scope, signatures, gate or resource cap go through the parent Q/A channel. Acceptance waits for the approved persistent mute auditor's checkpoints. Preserve full evidence outside the supervisor context and report command, candidate/tree, exit, duration and hashes, plus native token/cost data only when available. Proposed final subject: feat: route authenticated folds through the ruled economics.
